externalRequiredDocuments.name: Illinois State Police statewide criminal history transcript
externalRequiredDocuments.obtainedFrom: Illinois State Police, Bureau of Identification, through Access and Review
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Attend an Illinois law enforcement or correctional facility or a licensed fingerprint vendor, submit fingerprints and identifying information, and receive the transcript. Access and Review is free on the ISP fee schedule.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: Chicago Police Department RAP sheet
externalRequiredDocuments.conditionDescription: Only where there were Chicago arrests; the statewide transcript does not always capture them.
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Request the RAP sheet from the Chicago Police Department. A local fee applies.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: Certified disposition for each case
externalRequiredDocuments.obtainedFrom: Circuit clerk of each county where a case was filed
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Ask each circuit clerk for a certified copy of the disposition, and confirm copy counts, filing method and the exact fee.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: Prisoner Review Board certificate of eligibility
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Apply to the Prisoner Review Board for a certificate of eligibility for sealing or for expungement. The Board decides on an individualized rehabilitation showing.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: Educational documentation supporting the personal-history statement
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Obtain a copy of your high school diploma, GED, college diploma or transcripts.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: Employment documentation for the last five years
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Provide W-2s, tax returns, paycheck stubs or a letter from your employers covering the last five years.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: Proof of completion of any counselling
externalRequiredDocuments.conditionDescription: Where the participant attended anger management, marriage, substance-abuse or similar counselling.
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Ask the provider for proof of completion.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: DD-214 or similar proof of military service
externalRequiredDocuments.obtainedFrom: National Personnel Records Center or the service branch
externalRequiredDocuments.conditionDescription: Where the participant served in the military, and required for the military certificate branch.
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Request a copy of your DD-214.

externalRequiredDocuments.name: Fingerprint-based criminal history
externalRequiredDocuments.obtainedFrom: As directed in Guidelines paragraph B-5
externalRequiredDocuments.howToObtain: Follow paragraph B-5 of the Board's Guidelines for when and how to obtain fingerprints for criminal history.
